approval.cohort: Fourteen completed presidencies, Truman through Biden, ending January 2025
approval.limits: Tenures differ in length. Survey counts and weights are unspecified. This cohort is not inauguration approval or single-poll variability, and partisan polarization makes stationarity uncertain.

midterm.cohort: Nineteen midterms from 1950 through 2022, signed for the sitting President's party
midterm.unit: percentage points of national two-party House vote share
midterm.limits: Source rounds changes to one decimal and excludes unopposed districts where no vote was recorded. Approval averages and midterm changes are unpaired observations; these data establish no causal response coefficient.

derived.limits: Arithmetic over rounded observations; this sample SD describes observed outcomes, not residual model error. Observed extremes are not proven future bounds.

coverage: United States national observations spanning elections across states; not separate state, territorial or local response estimates.
integrationLimits: These cohorts are not paired with each other and establish no approval-to-vote or economy-to-approval response coefficient.
No production world draw, current approval poll, population drift, election result or causal effect is defined by this packet.
No normal distribution, future hard bound, residual error distribution or uniform response-strength range is established.
World creation must save any approved calibration once; reading and reopening a save must not sample. No approved sampling specification is implemented here.

responseModels.name: Tufte 1975
responseModels.inputs: N8 is presidential-party average House vote percentage over eight prior elections; P is September Gallup approval percentage; deltaE is election-year real disposable personal income per capita change in 1958 dollars.
gaps: The candidate does not supply the complete N8 and real-income inputs. GDP growth is not this income variable.
An independent historical swing mean cannot replace N8 or be added to this intercept.
No residual SD was verified; mean absolute error and coefficient standard errors do not establish it.

responseModels.name: Cory McCartan midterms-22
responseModels.inputs: October/latest pre-November poll approval logit; quarterly GDP and CPI year-over-year changes; logged unemployment; retirements; polarization; presidency and House control.
gaps: The inspected tree lacks the fitted intercept, seven regression coefficients, residual sigma and joint posterior.
The PCA loadings are not election-response coefficients. Saved prediction draws are not residual samples.
Raw source lineage, retirement denominator and an apparent repeated logistic transform in uncontested-vote imputation remain unresolved.
